authorization: User explicitly selected both models and no fee ceiling in this session.
order: Within each model: smoke once on real-boltons-slug/loop-on; then repeats 1..3, task order as listed, variant order rotated by repeat index. Independent models may run concurrently.
replacement_policy: All original trials retained. At most one separately recorded replacement per trial only after a failed/unknown run with provider timeout, connection/HTTP error, protocol truncation, or abnormal empty response. Algorithmic failures and budget exhaustion without those errors are not replaced. Report originals and replacements separately; no selection by success.
smoke_policy: No formal runs if offline/preflight/smoke infrastructure checks fail; a provider failure is retained and can receive one smoke replacement.
reporting: By model/task/variant, include all samples, repository and task pass true/false/null counts, status, steps, tokens, cost (unknown stays null), timing coverage, repetition distribution, first actual source change. Small-sample descriptive comparison only; do not claim causality from baseline, use loop-on/off for mechanism attribution.
